records.literal_gloss: A maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.

en.L: A maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
en.B: A maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer.
en.R: A song to teach, by David, from the time when he was in the cave. A prayer.

fr.L: Maskil de David, quand il était dans la caverne. Prière.
fr.B: Maskil de David, quand il était dans la caverne. Une prière.
fr.R: Un chant pour enseigner, de David, du temps où il était dans la caverne. Une prière.

sw.L: Maskili ya Daudi, alipokuwa pangoni. Maombi.
sw.B: Maskili ya Daudi, alipokuwa pangoni. Maombi.
sw.R: Wimbo wa kufundisha, wa Daudi, kutoka wakati alipokuwa pangoni. Maombi.

es.L: Masquil de David, cuando estaba en la cueva. Oración.
es.B: Masquil de David, cuando estaba en la cueva. Oración.
es.R: Canto para enseñar, de David, de cuando estaba en la cueva. Oración.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: maskil: a song of insight, or a skillful song
decisions.reason: As in 32:1. The word comes from the verb "to have insight, act wisely"; its exact sense as a heading is no longer known.

decisions.choice: David in the cave: 1 Samuel 22 and 24
decisions.reason: David hid from Saul in the cave of Adullam (1 Samuel 22:1) and in a cave near En-gedi (1 Samuel 24). The title of Psalm 57 also speaks of the cave.

decisions.choice: a prayer
decisions.reason: The word (tefillah) also heads Psalms 17, 86, 90 and 102.

decisions.choice: a song to teach
decisions.reason: As in 32:1, Readable gives the likeliest sense of the term (m2).

decisions.choice: "Maskil" kept as a name at Literal and Balanced; "Un chant pour enseigner" at Readable
decisions.reason: The meaning of maskil is not certain: a song of insight, or a skillful song. As the terms note sets, Literal and Balanced keep the word; Readable explains it as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Maskili" kept as a name at Literal and Balanced; "Wimbo wa kufundisha" (a song to teach) at Readable
decisions.reason: The meaning of maskil is not certain; it may be a song that teaches or a skilful song. Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew word in Swahili spelling, as the English keeps it; Readable gives the likely sense, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: masquil (L, B); Canto para enseñar (R)
decisions.reason: The meaning of maskil is uncertain; it may be a song that teaches or a skillful song. Literal and Balanced keep the word in its Spanish form, "masquil"; Readable follows the English Readable's "a song to teach".

source.text: ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: [With] my voice to YHWH I cry out; [with] my voice to YHWH I plead for favor.

en.L: [With] my voice I cry out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; [with] my voice I plead with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for mercy.
en.B: I call out loud to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I raise my voice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, pleading for mercy.
en.R: I cry out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help. I beg {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to be kind to me.

fr.L: [De] ma voix je crie vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; [de] ma voix je supplie {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} de me faire grâce.
fr.B: J’appelle à pleine voix {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; j’élève la voix vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour demander grâce.
fr.R: Je crie {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} pour qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’aide. Je supplie {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} d’être bon pour moi.

sw.L: [Kwa] sauti yangu ninamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; [kwa] sauti yangu ninamsihi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anihurumie.
sw.B: Ninamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sauti kubwa; ninapaza sauti yangu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nikiomba rehema.

es.L: [Con] mi voz clamo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; [con] mi voz suplico {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} que tenga piedad.
es.B: Clamo en voz alta {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; alzo mi voz {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, pidiéndole compasión.
es.R: Clamo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda. Le ruego {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} que sea bondadoso conmigo.

decisions.choice: plead for favor: beg for mercy
decisions.reason: The verb (chanan, reflexive) is to ask for grace or favor from one who has power to give it (30:9).

decisions.choice: cry out: call for help in distress
decisions.reason: The verb (za'aq) is the cry of someone in trouble (22:6; 107:13).

source.text: אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: I pour out before him my complaint; my trouble before him I declare.

en.L: I pour out before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} my complaint; my trouble before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} I declare.
en.B: I spill out my complaint in front of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; I tell {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all about my distress.
en.R: I tell {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} everything that is bothering me. I tell {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} all my troubles.

fr.L: Je répands devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ma plainte ; ma détresse, devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} je la déclare.
fr.B: Je déverse ma plainte devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} raconte toute ma détresse.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dis tout ce qui me tourmente. Je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} raconte tous mes malheurs.

sw.L: Ninamimina mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} malalamiko yangu; taabu yangu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ninaitangaza.
sw.B: Ninamwaga malalamiko yangu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; ninamweleza habari zote za dhiki yangu.
sw.R: Ninamweleza kila kitu kinachonisumbua. Ninamwambia taabu zangu zote.

es.L: Derramo delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mi queja; mi angustia delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} declaro.
es.B: Vacío mi queja delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} cuento toda mi angustia.
es.R: Le cuento todo lo que me inquieta. Le cuento todos mis problemas.

decisions.choice: complaint: an anxious pouring out of thoughts
decisions.reason: The word (siach) is talk or musing, often troubled thought spoken aloud (55:3; 102:1).

decisions.choice: pour out: speak everything without holding back
decisions.reason: As water is poured out, so the heart is poured out before God (62:9).

decisions.choice: him: the LORD
decisions.reason: The psalmist speaks of the LORD in the third person here, and turns to address him in verse 4.

source.text: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י׀רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: When it faints upon me, my spirit — and you, you know my path; in [the] way [that] I walk they have hidden a trap for me.

en.L: When my spirit grows faint within me, [then] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} — {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know my path. In [the] way [where] I walk they have hidden a trap for me.
en.B: When my spirit is fading within me, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one who knows my path. Along the road I travel they have hidden a trap for me.
en.R: When I feel too weak to go on, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know the way I am going. People have hidden a trap on the road where I walk.

fr.L: Quand mon esprit défaille en moi, [alors] {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} — {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais mon sentier. Sur [le] chemin [où] je marche, ils ont caché un piège pour moi.
fr.B: Quand mon esprit s’épuise en moi, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui connais mon sentier. Sur la route où je marche, ils m’ont caché un piège.
fr.R: Quand je me sens trop faible pour continuer, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} connais le chemin que je prends. Des gens ont caché un piège sur la route où je marche.

sw.L: Roho yangu inapozimia ndani yangu, [ndipo] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} — {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaijua njia yangu. Katika njia ninayotembea wamenifichia mtego.
sw.B: Roho yangu inapodhoofika ndani yangu, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiye unayeijua njia yangu. Katika barabara ninayosafiri wamenifichia mtego.
sw.R: Ninapojiona dhaifu mno kuendelea, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unaijua njia ninayoiendea. Watu wameficha mtego katika barabara ninayopita.

es.L: Cuando mi espíritu desfallece dentro de mí, [entonces] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} conoces mi senda. En [el] camino [por donde] ando me han escondido una trampa.
es.B: Cuando mi espíritu se apaga dentro de mí, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el que conoce mi senda. En el camino por donde voy me han escondido una trampa.
es.R: Cuando me siento demasiado débil para seguir, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sabes por dónde voy. La gente ha escondido una trampa en el camino por donde ando.

decisions.choice: faints: grows weak, is spent
decisions.reason: The same verb (hit'attef) is used in 77:4 and 143:4: the strength to go on is failing.

decisions.choice: you know my path: you see it and watch over it
decisions.reason: God's knowing is caring attention (1:6; 31:8). He sees the path, and the traps on it.

decisions.choice: you: stressed
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out: "you", and no one else, knows.

decisions.choice: people
decisions.reason: Readable says who "they" are in plain words: the psalmist's enemies.

source.text: הַבֵּ֤יט יָמִ֨ין׀וּרְאֵה֮ וְאֵֽין־לִ֪י מַ֫כִּ֥יר אָבַ֣ד מָנ֣וֹס מִמֶּ֑נִּי אֵ֖ין דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: Look [to the] right and see: and there is not for me one who takes notice; refuge has perished from me; there is not one who seeks for my soul.

en.L: Look [to the] right and see: there is no one who takes notice of me; refuge has perished from me; there is no one who cares for my soul.
en.B: Look to my right and see: there is no one who knows me. Every way of escape is gone; nobody looks out for me.
en.R: Look beside me and see. No one there knows me or pays attention to me. I have no place to run to. No one cares what happens to me.

fr.L: Regarde [à] droite et vois : il n’y a personne qui me reconnaisse ; le refuge m’a fait défaut ; il n’y a personne qui se soucie de mon âme.
fr.B: Regarde à ma droite et vois : personne ne me connaît. Toute issue a disparu ; personne ne veille sur moi.
fr.R: Regarde à côté de moi. Il n’y a là personne qui me connaisse ou qui fasse attention à moi. Je n’ai nulle part où me réfugier. Personne ne s’inquiète de ce qui m’arrive.

sw.L: Tazama [upande wa] kulia uone: hakuna anayenitambua; kimbilio limenipotea; hakuna anayeijali nafsi yangu.
sw.B: Tazama upande wangu wa kulia uone: hakuna anayenijua. Kila njia ya kukimbilia imetoweka; hakuna anayenitazamia.
sw.R: Tazama kando yangu uone. Hakuna mtu pale anayenijua au kunijali. Sina mahali pa kukimbilia. Hakuna anayejali yatakayonipata.

es.L: Mira a [la] derecha y ve: no hay quien me reconozca; el refugio se me ha perdido; no hay quien se interese por mi alma.
es.B: Mira a mi derecha y ve: no hay nadie que me conozca. Toda salida ha desaparecido; nadie se preocupa por mí.
es.R: Mira a mi lado y ve. Nadie allí me conoce ni me presta atención. No tengo adónde huir. A nadie le importa lo que me pase.

decisions.choice: the right: where a defender stands
decisions.reason: In a court or a battle the helper stood at a person's right hand (16:8; 109:31). No one stands there for the psalmist.

decisions.choice: look and see: commands to God
alternatives: I look to the right and see (the ancient Greek and other translations)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has forms that are best read as commands, "look" and "see". Ancient translations read "I look ... and see". The sense is much the same.

decisions.choice: one who takes notice: one who recognizes me as a friend
decisions.reason: The verb (nakar) is to recognize; here, to own someone as a friend (Ruth 2:10).

decisions.choice: refuge has perished from me: there is no escape
decisions.reason: The word (manos) is a place to flee to (59:17). For him it is lost.

source.text: זָעַ֥קְתִּי אֵלֶ֗יךָ יְה֫וָ֥ה אָ֭מַרְתִּי אַתָּ֣ה מַחְסִ֑י חֶ֝לְקִ֗י בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַֽחַיִּים׃

records.literal_gloss: I cry out to you, YHWH; I say, You [are] my refuge, my portion in [the] land of the living.

en.L: I have cried out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; I have said, "You [are] my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."
en.B: I cry out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}. I say, "You are my shelter, all I have in the land of the living."
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I cry out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. I say, "You are the place where I am safe. You are all I have while I am alive."

fr.L: J’ai crié vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; j’ai dit : « Toi, [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es] mon refuge, ma part sur la terre des vivants. »
fr.B: Je crie vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je dis : « Tu es mon abri, tout ce que j’ai sur la terre des vivants. »
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je crie vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Je dis : « Tu es l’endroit où je suis en sécurité. Tu es tout ce que j’ai tant que je suis en vie. »

sw.L: Nimekulilia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nimesema, "Wewe [ni] kimbilio langu, fungu langu katika nchi ya walio hai."
sw.B: Ninakulilia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ninasema, "Wewe ni kimbilio langu, kila nilicho nacho katika nchi ya walio hai."
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninakulilia {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. Ninasema, "Wewe ndiye mahali ninapokuwa salama. Wewe ndiye kila kitu nilicho nacho maadamu niko hai."

es.L: He clamado a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; he dicho: «Tú [eres] mi refugio, mi porción en la tierra de los vivientes».
es.B: Clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Digo: «Tú eres mi refugio, todo lo que tengo en la tierra de los vivientes».
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, clamo a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Digo: «Tú eres el lugar donde estoy a salvo. Tú eres todo lo que tengo mientras vivo».

decisions.choice: my portion: my share, all that is mine
decisions.reason: A portion (cheleq) was a family's share of the land. The Levites had no land; the LORD was their portion (Numbers 18:20). The psalmist says the same (16:5; 73:26).

decisions.choice: the land of the living: this life
decisions.reason: As in 27:13 and 116:9, the world of the living, in contrast to the place of the dead.

decisions.choice: refuge: a shelter to run to
decisions.reason: As in 46:2 (machaseh).

decisions.choice: all I have
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the portion means (m1).

source.text: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה׀אֶֽל־רִנָּתִי֮ כִּֽי־דַלּ֪וֹתִ֫י מְאֹ֥ד הַצִּילֵ֥נִי מֵרֹדְפַ֑י כִּ֖י אָמְצ֣וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Pay attention to my cry, for I have been brought low exceedingly; deliver me from those pursuing me, for they are stronger than I.

en.L: Pay attention to my cry, for I have been brought very low; deliver me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.
en.B: Pay heed to my cry, because I am in the depths. Rescue me from those who hunt me, since they are stronger than I am.
en.R: Please listen to me when I cry for help. I am in deep trouble. Save me from the people who are chasing me. They are stronger than I am.

fr.L: Sois attentif à mon cri, car je suis tombé très bas ; délivre-moi de ceux qui me poursuivent, car ils sont plus forts que moi.
fr.B: Prête attention à mon cri, car je suis au plus bas. Délivre-moi de ceux qui me traquent, car ils sont plus forts que moi.
fr.R: Écoute-moi quand je crie au secours. Je suis dans un grand malheur. Sauve-moi des gens qui me poursuivent. Ils sont plus forts que moi.

sw.L: Usikilize kilio changu, kwa maana nimeshushwa chini sana; uniokoe na wale wanaonifuatia, kwa maana wana nguvu kuliko mimi.
sw.B: Ukisikilize kilio changu, kwa sababu niko vilindini. Uniokoe na wale wanaoniwinda, kwa kuwa wana nguvu kuliko mimi.
sw.R: Tafadhali unisikilize ninapolilia msaada. Niko katika taabu kubwa. Uniokoe na watu wanaonifukuza. Wana nguvu kuliko mimi.

es.L: Atiende a mi clamor, porque he sido abatido en extremo; líbrame de los que me persiguen, porque son más fuertes que yo.
es.B: Presta atención a mi clamor, porque estoy en lo más hondo. Rescátame de los que me acosan, porque son más fuertes que yo.
es.R: Por favor, escúchame cuando clamo pidiendo ayuda. Estoy en un problema muy grande. Sálvame de la gente que me persigue. Son más fuertes que yo.

decisions.choice: stronger than I: as in Psalm 18:18
decisions.reason: The same words are used in 18:18 of David's enemies, from whom God rescued him.

decisions.choice: brought low: weak, helpless
decisions.reason: The verb (dalal) is to be low, poor and weak (79:8; 116:6).

decisions.choice: those pursuing me: those who hunt me down
decisions.reason: As Saul pursued David (1 Samuel 23:25; title, verse 1).

source.text: ה֘וֹצִ֤יאָה מִמַּסְגֵּ֨ר׀נַפְשִׁי֮ לְהוֹד֪וֹת אֶת־שְׁ֫מֶ֥ךָ בִּ֭י יַכְתִּ֣רוּ צַדִּיקִ֑ים כִּ֖י תִגְמֹ֣ל עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Bring out from prison my soul, to give thanks to your name; about me they will surround, [the] righteous, for you will deal fully with me.

en.L: Bring my soul out of prison, to give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. [The] righteous will gather around me, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will deal bountifully with me.
en.B: Lead me out of this prison, so that I may thank {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name. Then the righteous will crowd around me, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will treat me with goodness.
en.R: Free me from this prison so I can thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for who {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. Then good people will gather around me, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be good to me.

fr.L: Fais sortir mon âme de la prison, pour rendre grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. [Les] justes m’entoureront, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me feras du bien.
fr.B: Fais-moi sortir de cette prison, pour que je rende grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom. Alors les justes se presseront autour de moi, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’auras fait du bien.
fr.R: Libère-moi de cette prison, pour que je puisse {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier pour ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es. Alors les gens bons viendront autour de moi, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} auras été bon pour moi.

sw.L: Itoe nafsi yangu gerezani, ili nilishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. Wenye haki watanizunguka, kwa maana utanitendea kwa ukarimu.
sw.B: Unitoe katika gereza hili, ili nipate kulishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}. Ndipo wenye haki watakusanyika kunizunguka, kwa sababu utanitendea mema.
sw.R: Uniweke huru kutoka gereza hili ili nikushukuru kwa jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo. Ndipo watu wema watakusanyika kunizunguka, kwa sababu utakuwa mwema kwangu.

es.L: Saca mi alma de la cárcel, para dar gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. Me rodearán [los] justos, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me tratarás con generosidad.
es.B: Sácame de esta cárcel, para que dé gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre. Entonces los justos se reunirán a mi alrededor, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me tratarás con bondad.
es.R: Líbrame de esta cárcel para que pueda darte gracias por lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres. Entonces la gente buena se reunirá a mi alrededor, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} serás bueno conmigo.

decisions.choice: prison: the trap of his distress
decisions.reason: The prison may be the cave of the title, or a picture of trouble that shuts him in (88:9).

decisions.choice: will surround me: will gather around me
alternatives: will crown themselves because of me
decisions.reason: The verb (katar) means to surround, or in another form to crown. The righteous will gather to celebrate with him.

decisions.choice: deal fully: do good, repay with kindness
decisions.reason: The verb (gamal) is to deal out in full, here God's goodness (13:6; 116:7).

decisions.choice: this prison
decisions.reason: "This" makes clear that the psalmist speaks of the place he is in now.

decisions.choice: for who you are; good people
